title: MZR archive census — graphics-first proposal
scope: T1 VizieR metadata enumeration and its limits; no eligibility result and no MZR measurement

beats.narration: This is a census of VizieR catalogue metadata: it asks which single tables are reachable for gas-phase abundance, stellar mass, and redshift together.
beats.visual_action: Open on three labeled metadata columns flowing into one archive-table icon; reveal a persistent badge: METADATA CENSUS — NOT AN MZR MEASUREMENT, plus the persistent subtitle SINGLE-TABLE METADATA INTERSECTION — CROSS-TABLE JOINS AND CROSSMATCHES NOT ASSESSED.

beats.narration: The search combined semantic UCD tags with column-name variants, and each frozen query returned exactly its pre-counted rows.
beats.visual_action: Reveal two channel rails labeled UCD and NAME VARIANTS; show zero channel failures without a decorative plot.
beats.display_citation: IVOA UCD1+ v1.5; NebulaMind VizieR census, 2026-08-05

beats.narration: UCD plus name matching reached 5,568 abundance tables, 6,206 mass tables, and 6,687 redshift tables; the name channel added 175, 88, and 20 respectively.
beats.visual_action: Use three equal-width axis cards. Each card shows UCD count, plus-name count, and gain. Label: counts, not area encoded.

beats.narration: The three axis lists intersected at 178 candidate tables.
beats.visual_action: Merge the three rails into one large node labeled THREE-AXIS REACH: 178.

beats.narration: Modifier columns then emptied a required axis in 21 tables: 19 on redshift and 2 on abundance, leaving 157 recorded candidates.
beats.visual_action: Animate 178 → minus 21 → 157. Split and group the dropped branch into visible bins: 19 REDSHIFT AXIS EMPTIED with e_Z and e_[Z/H] examples; 2 ABUNDANCE AXIS EMPTIED with e_Ha/Hb, e_logOI/Ha, and l_logOI/Ha examples.

beats.narration: As a side check, a frozen term regex matched 62 of those 157 recorded descriptions; it is not an eligibility filter, and T2 still applies to all 157.
beats.visual_action: Connect 157 directly to T2. Branch 62 downward as a side inset labeled FROZEN TERM-REGEX MATCH IN RECORDED DESCRIPTIONS and SIDE CHECK ONLY — T2 STILL APPLIES TO ALL 157.

beats.narration: All seven pinned recall members returned, while none of the three controls appeared.
beats.visual_action: Show two explicit scorecards: RECALL 7/7 and CONTROLS APPEARING 0/3, with seven blue checks and three green absences.

beats.narration: Those checks validate retrieval, not precision: the frozen controls did not cover the dominant precision-contamination mode.
beats.visual_action: Keep 7/7 and 0/3 on the left; add an amber PRECISION NOT CERTIFIED panel on the right and open two groups of recorded examples.
beats.display_citation: IVOA UCD1+ v1.5; NebulaMind VizieR census, 2026-08-05

beats.narration: Recorded examples separate symbol-and-meaning collisions—Galactic height and model-grid metal fraction—from target-domain mismatches: stellar gravitational redshift and gravitational-redshift velocity. They are not T2 rulings.
beats.visual_action: Group the four recorded examples under SYMBOL / MEANING COLLISION and TARGET-DOMAIN MISMATCH; hold RECORDED EXAMPLES — NOT T2 RULINGS above them and use no trend geometry.

beats.narration: The T2 rule contract is frozen, but the 157-table eligibility application is not completed, so no eligible-table count or metallicity measurement is reportable yet.
beats.visual_action: End the direct 157-to-T2 path at a qualified gate: CONTRACT FROZEN — APPLICATION NOT COMPLETED — NO ELIGIBLE-TABLE COUNT. Hold REPORTABLE NOW versus PENDING.
beats.display_citation: NebulaMind pre-registered T2 eligibility protocol v1.8, frozen 2026-08-06

visual_rejections: Do not use the metallicity-versus-redshift literature scatter in this census explainer.
Do not render internal paths or filenames as audience citations.
Do not make 62 look like a terminal eligible sample.
Do not draw 62 in series as a filter feeding T2; T2 applies to all 157.
Do not omit the single-table scope or imply that cross-table joins and crossmatches were assessed.
Do not hide the 19/2 dropped-row reasons inside body prose.
Do not call the archive census a metallicity measurement or flagship galaxy-evolution study.
audio_contract: Alloy through Nous at speed 1.18 per Hwao order; manifest proposal only here, no TTS invocation.
